blurb: Guests can rent kayaks or paddleboards or join guided tours to explore wildlife-rich waters in Santa Cruz Harbor, Monterey Bay, and Elkhorn Slough. Tours include wildlife viewing of sea otters, seals, birds, and sometimes whales. Rentals and tours cater to beginners and families, with expert guides and safety equipment provided.
